Container.Name: AccessFlow
Container.Overview: Self-hosted portal to manage users, subscriptions and invites for a personal Plex server: roles, plans, renewals, payment reports, email/Telegram reminders. Requires APP_SECRET_KEY (>=32 random chars) and, to invite/manage Plex users, PLEX_TOKEN + PLEX_SERVER_NAME. Put the app behind a reverse proxy (NPM/SWAG/Traefik) and set PUBLIC_BASE_URL to your https:// URL.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Container Port: 8000

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: SQLite DB + backups + secrets. Container Path: /data

Config.Name: App Secret Key
Config.Description: REQUIRED. Random string >=32 chars, the app refuses to start without it. Generate: python -c "import secrets;print(secrets.token_urlsafe(48))"

Config.Name: Public Base URL
Config.Description: Your public https:// URL (through the reverse proxy). Needed for Secure session cookies.

Config.Name: Forwarded Allow IPs
Config.Description: Reverse proxy source IP/subnet uvicorn trusts for X-Forwarded-*. Never "*" if exposed directly. Unraid docker bridge is typically 172.17.0.0/16.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Timezone for schedules/reminders/backups.

Config.Name: Default Locale
Config.Description: UI language (it/en).

Config.Name: SuperAdmin Username
Config.Description: Local login username, seeded on first boot.

Config.Name: SuperAdmin Password
Config.Description: Leave blank: a random password is generated and logged once at first boot (change it later from /profile).

Config.Name: Plex Token
Config.Description: Admin Plex token, used for invites + OAuth. https://support.plex.tv/articles/204059436

Config.Name: Plex Server Name
Config.Description: Name of the Plex server to manage.

Config.Name: Plex Direct URL
Config.Description: Optional: connect straight to this Plex baseurl (plex.direct dashed-host form), skipping plex.tv discovery. Leave blank for normal discovery.

Config.Name: Plex Client ID
Config.Description: Optional: stable Plex client identifier. Derived from the secret key if left blank.

Config.Name: Plex Revoke On Delete
Config.Description: Revoke the user's Plex server access when their AccessFlow account is deleted.

Config.Name: Telegram Bot Token
Config.Description: Optional: enables the Telegram reminder bot. From @BotFather.

Config.Name: Telegram Bot Username
Config.Description: Bot username (without @), used for deep links.

Config.Name: SMTP Host
Config.Description: Optional: enables email reminders.

Config.Name: SMTP From
Config.Description: From address for reminder emails.

Config.Name: SMTP From Name
Config.Description: Display name in the From header.

Config.Name: Notify Hour
Config.Description: Hour (0-23, server TZ) the daily expiration scan + reminders run.

Config.Name: Reminder Days Before
Config.Description: Comma-separated days-before-expiry to send reminders. Admin-editable in Settings too.

Config.Name: Reminder Days After
Config.Description: Comma-separated overdue days for dunning follow-ups. Admin-editable in Settings too.

Config.Name: Digest Lookahead Days
Config.Description: Manager weekly-digest lookahead window in days. Admin-editable in Settings too.

Config.Name: Backup Keep
Config.Description: How many nightly SQLite backups to keep.

Config.Name: Enable Scheduler
Config.Description: Run the daily reminder/backup scheduler in-process.

Config.Name: Enable Telegram Bot
Config.Description: Run the Telegram bot (polling) in-process.
